notes.title: Rot Gut OST long-awaited update
notes.content:
Hi,

It always bugged me that Rot Gut's OST needed a bit more love. I finally sat down and fixed it. Hope you like the little Quality of Life changes.

Also made a bundle for the game and OST called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53432/Rot_Gut__Double_Distilled_Edition/]Double Distilled[/url].

PeaCe,
-idn

notes.title: OST + New Patch is up!

Best,
